channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Danuel House | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Danuel House from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Danuel House
item.description:
#Sixers coachDoc Rivers on Danuel House Jr.:

“I love him. I love his spirit before he gets on the court. I love his talk. He’s one of the other guys that talks a lot. “But he shoots the ball. He’s just playing very, very smart basketball.”

Doc Rivers on Danuel House, Oct 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Danuel House
item.description:
Daryl Morey (@Daryl Morey) on House:

“Danuel is a very talented two-way player who immediately bolsters our wing depth and strengthens our roster... I'm excited for Danuel's future in Philadelphia.”

Daryl Morey on Danuel House, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Danuel House
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas:

“Definitely not an easy thing with House (@Danuel House). He was here when I first got here and he’s had some really good moments,particularly the Chicago game where he came in and made four threes and started our winning streak. He’s a great person.”

Stephen Silas on Danuel House, Dec 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Danuel House
item.description:
Eric Gordon on the whether Danuel House Jr. needs to rebuild trust in the locker room:

“No. He just needs to play basketball. ... He's just got to come out and play. I wouldn't say that he needs to worry about anything.”

Eric Gordon on Danuel House, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: James Harden on Danuel House
item.description:
Rockets’ James Harden on Danuel House investigation:

“It affected us because obviously it’s a distraction and he’s a huge part of our rotation. You still have to go out there and try to compete and try to win games.”

James Harden on Danuel House, Sep 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Danuel House
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Danuel House:

“I think he's blossoming into one of the better players in the league... I still think he'll improve and get better.”

Mike D'Antoni on Danuel House, Sep 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Danuel House
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D’Antoni on @Danuel House who is out today:

“He has a big toe that he stubbed. He needs probably a day to get over it. No use pushing it. He’s been playing a lot of minutes anyway. So (with a) back-to-back, it’s probably better if we try to get it totally well.”

Mike D'Antoni on Danuel House, Aug 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Danuel House
item.description:
Mark Berman:Steve Kerr on @Danuel House:

“He had a really good camp for us. It literally came down to the final day.. He almost made our team. Really happy for him. He's done a great job with Houston. He's found a home.”

Steve Kerr on Danuel House, Apr 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Daryl Morey, Danuel House
item.description:
AgentRaymond Brothers on @Danuel House returning to the #Rockets for the rest of the season:

“I'm thanking Daryl Morey and the Rockets for trying to work out a long-term deal. We'll revisit it in the summer.”

Raymond Brothers on Daryl Morey, Danuel House, Mar 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: James Harden on Austin Rivers, Kenneth Faried, Danuel House
item.description:
James Harden on persevering:

“A rough stretch. Chris goes out. We get Austin luckily. Clint goes out. We get Kenneth luckily. Lose D-House. As long as we can keep our head above water until these guys get back, ... we’re good. We know as a healthy unit, we can beat anybody.”

James Harden on Austin Rivers, Kenneth Faried, Danuel House, Jan 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: James Harden on Danuel House
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:James Harden on Danuel House, Jr.'s success:

“It’s encouraging to see, especially a young guy… just out there working, wanting to get better and wanting to learn and compete. It makes me want to get better, also.”

James Harden on Danuel House, Dec 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.
